meta.sourceNote: Revenue values are official revised estimates. Right-hand categories are a citizen-view grouping for communication and are fully editable.
meta.basisNote: Figures are on the fiscal-balance basis: expenditure here excludes debt amortisation (repayment of principal), which is a financing item. Headline 'total spending' of about BDS$5.1bn quoted around the Estimates includes amortisation and is therefore not comparable with the BDS$3.9bn shown here.
